slides.text: Summary: bursting elastic sheets 1. Hoop stretch r /ξ: a resistance Gh0 ln(R/R0) subtracts from the Newtonian pull 2. Without relaxation it arrests: Ec ln(R∞/R0) → 2 as Ec → 0 3. Soft sheets thicken at the edge: H∞/h0 ∼ Ec 4. Finite relaxation releases the arrest −1/3
